columns.label: C25 GL Δ
columns.acceptance: Every money-moving action on the leaf writes a balanced journal entry, and the GL delta equals the amount the surface displayed. PROOF: kind sql. Create through the live UI, then assert sum(debit_amount)=sum(credit_amount) AND net movement on the target account equals the amount rendered. Both required. A leaf that moves no money is NA, not PASS.

columns.label: C26 Subledger
columns.acceptance: The module's subledger total ties to its GL control account for a stated period. AR=AR control. AP=AP control. Driver escrow=escrow liability. Bank register=cash control. PROOF: kind sql, (subledger_sum - control_sum)=0. Period must be named in the proof. Accounting C26 stays red until GO-ACCT-01 DEFECT A nets (cash credits $177,411.20 vs debits $13,503.70).

columns.label: C27 Lifecycle
columns.acceptance: Every status the record can hold is reachable, and every terminal status either posts or reverses. No status may strand money. PROOF: kind sql or dom. Enumerate statuses from the enum or check constraint — not a hand-written list — and show GL effect of each transition, all exercised. A DB status missing from the proof is automatic FAIL.

columns.label: C28 Reversal
columns.acceptance: Voiding or reversing a posted transaction writes an equal and opposite entry. Never delete and never edit the original. Debits and credits swap. Original stays readable forever. PROOF: kind sql. Post, reverse; two entries exist, net to zero; original unchanged (same id, amounts, created_at). WORM: void by UUID, never DELETE a financial row.

columns.owner_status: APPROVED 2026-08-30 UNBUILDABLE until period close ships

Close a period, ATTEMPT a post into it, assert the write is REFUSED. 16 C29 cells stay red until Cursor ships period close in its own dedicated session.
